overloads.semanticRole: Selects the form object identified by name (a string) as the active data entry area.

discriminatedBy.rule: When * is passed, object is interpreted as an object name (Text) rather than a direct field/variable reference.

overloads.semanticRole: Selects the given field or variable object directly (by reference) as the active data entry area.

discriminatedBy.rule: When * is omitted, object must be a direct Field or Variable reference rather than a name string.

constraints: Passing an empty object name (with * specified) removes focus from any object in the current form.
When called from a subform, first searches for the object within the subform, then extends the search to the parent form's objects if not found there.
